title: Canonical etale-origin change of compactification for trace coordinates
statement: Let A be a finite commutative coefficient ring, g:Z→S quasi-compact, c and d compactifications of g [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], W an object of the pro-etale derived category [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and hW a bounded-below etale-origin certificate [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Define originChange(A,c,d,W,hW) by taking a bounded-below ordinary representative L and comparison isomorphism e provided by hW, composing Rc!(e)^(-1), the canonical rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationOriginIso(c,d) at L, and Rd!(e). The middle is the existing compactification comparison from [thm-sf-comp-composition], not an arbitrarily chosen isomorphism. Naturality makes the result independent of the representative. This only defines that actual comparison; it asserts no trace equality.

def originChange {Z S : Scheme.{u}} {g : Z ⟶ S} [QuasiCompact g]
    (c d : Compactification g) (W : D A Z)
    (hW : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z W) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj W ≅
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d).obj W
